name: Grupo Dos
description: Uruguayan online store for kitchenware, home goods, small appliances, air conditioners and hardware. Offers same-day delivery in Montevideo, dispatch to the country by agency, and free pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de artículos de cocina, hogar, pequeños electrodomésticos, aires acondicionados y ferretería. Ofrece entrega en el día en Montevideo, despacho al interior por agencia y retiro gratis en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Flash and Express delivery cover Montevideo and coverage zones; dispatch to the Tres Cruces terminal reaches the whole country through the agency chosen by the buyer.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at the local in Montevideo; buyer is notified by email when the order is ready.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Catalog is mainly kitchen, bazaar and home goods with some appliances, air conditioners and console accessories; no TV or audio seen. Robots.txt disallows /carrito, /finalizar-compra and /api.

sources.supports: Shipping page: Flash (Montevideo), Express, dispatch to Tres Cruces terminal for the whole country, free pickup
Home page: category list (small appliances, air conditioners, console accessories) and add-to-cart
